## What & why

## Kind of change
- [ ] Editorial (typos, clarity, tooling)
- [ ] Normative (changes what compliance means) → schema + spec version + CHANGELOG updated together

## Definition of done
- [ ] `pytest` green
- [ ] `atlas check` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under Unreleased
- [ ] ADR added, if this changes the repository's shape or the standard's direction
